exposure: early ambulation (less than 8 hours after spinal anesthesia)
late ambulation (after 15 hours after spinal anesthesia)
cohort: 230 mothers undergoing elective cesarean surgery at Kamali Hospital of Alborz Province in Iran.
finding: The study found no significant difference in most measured side effects between early and late ambulation after spinal anesthesia, with only one participant in the late ambulation group experiencing urinary retention at 24 hours.
